scenarios.title: S2→S3 cross-sprint flow: POST /inward + POST /sales + POST /adjustments via S2 stack → GET /dashboard via S3 stack reflects all 3 movement types
flow: Seed master via SQL: 1 supplier (Manjunatha @ Mallur), 2 staff, 1 dealer (Raj @ Mysuru), 1 design (16X10 Ridges 16X10), 1 grade ('1'), 1 active DesignGradeMap pair
S2 WRITE PATH (real HTTP, real services, real domain.stock with advisory-lock-first):
• POST /api/v1/inward purchase_date=2026-06-05 nos=100 → InwardService → domain.stock.apply_inward → ledger row delta=+100 running=100
• POST /api/v1/sales sales_date=2026-06-10 nos=30 → SalesService → domain.stock.apply_sale → ledger row delta=-30 running=70
• POST /api/v1/adjustments stock_date=2026-06-20 entry_date=2026-06-25 physical_cb=65 → AdjustmentService computes diff=-5 → domain.stock.apply_adjustment → ledger row delta=-5 running=65
S3 READ PATH (separate HTTP call, real DashboardService composing all the above):
• GET /api/v1/dashboard?as_of_date=2026-06-30 → DashboardService.list_as_of
• opening_balance(2026-06-01) → 0 (no May ledger)
• LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type(2026-06-01, 2026-06-30) → inward=100, outward=30, adjust=-5
• FORMULA-001 invariant: 0 + 100 - 30 + (-5) = 65 ✓
scenarios.exit_assertion: All 3 POSTs return 201 (or 200, per service contract); GET /dashboard returns 200 with exactly 1 row: opening=0, inward=100, outward=30, adjust=-5, closing=65, design_name='16X10 Ridges', grade_code='1'. FORMULA-001 holds. Verifies that S3 read code correctly aggregates what S2 write code produces through the full HTTP+service+domain stack — no shortcuts, no test-only seeding of the ledger.

flow: Seed master: 1 supplier, 2 staff, 1 design, 1 grade, 1 active pair

execution_results.fix_root_cause: Step A scenario used absolute date 2026-06-05 for the inward POST. By the time the test ran (2026-06-29), that's 24 days back — InwardService correctly rejected with AC-021 'purchase_date cannot be older than 7 days' (HTTP 422).
execution_results.fix_summary: Rewrote test to compute txn_date = date.today() - timedelta(days=1) (within AC-021's 7-day window). Added month-boundary guard: per-movement assertions branch on whether txn_date and today fall in the same calendar month (both branches still satisfy FORMULA-001 and yield closing=65). Production code untouched.
execution_results.output: PASS after fix. 3 POSTs (inward, sales, adjustments) all returned 201; GET /api/v1/dashboard returned 1 row with closing=65 and FORMULA-001 holding. S2→S3 cross-sprint contract verified end-to-end through the real HTTP+service+domain stack.
